parameters.name: AppType
parameters.description: The file type. Valid values: source-map: SourceMap files. mapping: symbol table files for Android. dsym: dSYM files for iOS.

parameters.name: Pid
parameters.description: The process ID (PID) of the application.

parameters.name: VersionId
parameters.description: The version number of the files. If you do not specify this parameter, all versions of the files are returned by default.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun arms get-rum-upload-files --app-type source-map --pid aoxxxxxly@741623b4e910000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --version-id 1.0.0 --page-size 1 --next-token example-string --file-name example-string --workspace example-string --service-id example-string --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
